prompts.prompt: Explore this materials dataset, summarize its quality, and map its compositions in composition space.
Evaluate these materials-model predictions and explain the largest errors and limitations.
Inspect this crystal structure, map its CrystalNN local environment and coordination polyhedra, then compare the supplied experimental XRD peaks with its theoretical pattern.
Analyze this trajectory, show the RDF and MSD, and estimate diffusion over the full supplied time range with fit diagnostics.
Show the supplied phonon bands and density of states together with the matching Brillouin-zone context.
Inspect this supplied volumetric grid and show its supported slice and volume views.
Inspect the supplied electronic band structure and DOS, including gap, spin, projection and compatibility limitations.
